questions.question: What keyboard shortcut copies selected text or items to the clipboard?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+C duplicates the selection to the clipboard without deleting it.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut pastes clipboard contents at the cursor?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+V inserts the most recently copied or cut item.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut cuts the selected item?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+X removes the selection and stores it on the clipboard.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut undoes the last action?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+Z reverts the most recent change in most applications.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut selects all content in the current window or document?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+A highlights everything so it can be copied, deleted, or formatted at once.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut saves the current document?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+S stores the document's current state to disk.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens the print dialog?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+P is the universal shortcut for printing in most programs.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens the find tool to search for text?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+F locates words or phrases within documents and web pages.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut switches between open windows or applications?
questions.explanation: Alt+Tab cycles through running programs in the order they were used.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut closes the active window or exits the application?
questions.explanation: Alt+F4 closes the focused window; on the desktop it opens the shutdown menu.

questions.question: Which function key refreshes or reloads a web page?
questions.explanation: F5 reloads the current page in browsers and File Explorer views.

questions.question: Which function key renames a selected file or folder in File Explorer?
questions.explanation: F2 enters rename mode for the highlighted item.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut creates a new document in most applications?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+N opens a blank new document or, in browsers, a new window.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens an existing document or file?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+O displays the file-open dialog in most applications.

questions.question: What keyboard shortcut opens the Windows security screen with lock, sign-out, and Task Manager options?
questions.explanation: Ctrl+Alt+Delete is the secure attention sequence that presents security options.
